verdict.rationale: Solid's own README documents official starter templates (`npx degit solidjs/templates/js my-app`, plus a TypeScript variant) that create a minimal, client-rendered Vite application, which delivers the core of scaffolding a new project from an official starter. missing for 10: a dedicated first-party CLI (degit is a generic cloning tool), documented install/run/dev-server steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration that setup takes only a few minutes.
